curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When foam swords and fake incantations awaken an actual demon in the woods, how do make-believe knights survive an authentic supernatural slaughter?
curatedMovie.description: Three dedicated friends head into the woods for a live-action role-playing game, only to unleash real hell when an online prop spellbook turns out to be an authentic grimoire that summons a bloodthirsty succubus.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast, funny, and excitingly absurd, this 85-minute horror comedy delivers light, low-stress entertainment for a group watch.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Joe Lynch, this fast and irreverent horror-comedy throws mock fantasy warriors into real demonic chaos, making it an energetic watch packed with chaotic charm.
